written.basis: Independent native locators: same UUID assistant records; tool_use id and tool_result tool_use_id; source-reported session identity and final output token scopes. Validated on 2.1.316 original SDK bytes and native session file.

entities.name: assistant record
entities.basis: both sources write each assistant record under its uuid; the lifecycle stage of each record is read from its own stop_reason (streamed or final), never from the candidate (ACCT-1)

entities.name: tool result
entities.basis: a tool_result block names its call by tool_use_id

totals.name: response_final_output_tokens
totals.basis: each API message's output tokens once, from the session file's assistant records (stop_reason set); the stream's are provisional

totals.name: run_output_tokens
totals.basis: the result record's run usage, once: the scope 4 observation that states no aggregation (the run's last response, at the same scope with aggregation 3 Single response, is not part of it)

authorities.basis: The stream reports the CLI structured result object. The session file toolUseResult can be rendered text; that distinct representation stays on its source observation.

A sub-agent's prompt is a content block array in the stream and a plain string in its session file; a string has no native block type, so the stream's is kept and the session file's representation stays on its observation.
